routes.label: 4 Av-9 St → 14 St-8 Av (F to W 4 St, then A/C/E)
routes.top: F and A/C/E lateness at W 4 St-Wash Sq move together (Spearman +0.49, p=0.000, 421 bins). Both lines are disrupted (mean lateness ≥4 min) in the same 15 min 2.4× more often than chance.
routes.dominant: wait for the F at 4 Av-9 St

routes.label: 4 Av-9 St → 14 St-8 Av (F to Jay St, cross-platform to A/C)
routes.top: F and A/C lateness at Jay St-MetroTech move together (Spearman +0.42, p=0.000, 407 bins). Both lines are disrupted (mean lateness ≥4 min) in the same 15 min 2.3× more often than chance.
routes.dominant: wait for the F at 4 Av-9 St

routes.label: 4 Av-9 St → 14 St-8 Av (R to Jay St, then A/C)
routes.top: R and A/C lateness at Jay St-MetroTech move together (Spearman +0.45, p=0.000, 400 bins). Both lines are disrupted (mean lateness ≥4 min) in the same 15 min 2.9× more often than chance. The correlation peaks when R leads by 30 min, so R delays precede A/C delays.
routes.dominant: wait for the R at 4 Av-9 St

routes.label: 14 St-8 Av → 4 Av-9 St (A/C/E to W 4 St, then F)
routes.top: A/C/E and F lateness at W 4 St-Wash Sq move together (Spearman +0.60, p=0.000, 416 bins). Both lines are disrupted (mean lateness ≥4 min) in the same 15 min 2.0× more often than chance.
routes.dominant: wait for the A/C/E at 14 St

routes.label: 14 St-8 Av → 4 Av-9 St (A/C to Jay St, cross-platform to F)
routes.top: A/C and F lateness at Jay St-MetroTech move together (Spearman +0.31, p=0.000, 384 bins). Both lines are disrupted (mean lateness ≥4 min) in the same 15 min 1.5× more often than chance. The correlation peaks when F leads by 30 min, so F delays precede A/C delays.
routes.dominant: wait for the A/C at 14 St

routes.label: 14 St-8 Av → 4 Av-9 St (A/C to Jay St, then R)
routes.top: A/C and R lateness at Jay St-MetroTech move together (Spearman +0.31, p=0.000, 370 bins). Both lines are disrupted (mean lateness ≥4 min) in the same 15 min 2.1× more often than chance. The correlation peaks when R leads by 30 min, so R delays precede A/C delays.
routes.dominant: wait for the A/C at 14 St
